School of International Policy and Governance
The School of International Policy and Governance (SIPG)
at Laurier is a community of scholars and
students
working on the broad themes
and problems arising from the globalization of economic, political and social
systems. SIPG offers several
programs
at the graduate level, and one
Certificate for Laurier undergraduate students.
